step1.title: New Nuki device
step1.description: Enter the Bluetooth address and, if available, the device security PIN. Bridge replaces an existing bridge pairing; App keeps an existing bridge.

choose_method.description: Choose how to configure {name} ({address}). Before pairing, hold the Nuki button for 5 seconds until its light stays on. Import existing keys only if you already have the pairing credentials.

pair.title: Pair Nuki
pair.description: Check the device is in pairing mode and try again. If needed, enter its security PIN.

manual.title: Import existing pairing
manual.description: Enter the credentials of an existing Bluetooth pairing.

reconfigure.title: Change security PIN
reconfigure.description: Enter the security PIN currently set on the Nuki. Leave empty to remove the stored PIN. This preserves the Bluetooth pairing and existing entities.

error.invalid_address: Enter a Bluetooth address such as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
error.invalid_pin: Enter a valid numeric security PIN for this device.
error.pin_required: This Nuki requires its security PIN for pairing.
error.invalid_key: Enter a hexadecimal key of the required length (8 characters for the authorization ID, 64 for keys).
error.invalid_app_id: Enter an app ID between 0 and 4294967295.
error.key_mismatch: The public key does not match the private key.
error.connection: Could not connect to the Nuki over Bluetooth. Try again when it is reachable.
error.pairing: Nuki is not in pairing mode. Hold its button for 5 seconds, then try again.
error.pairing_failed: Nuki rejected pairing. Check pairing mode, the security PIN and available authorizations, then try again.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration of this Nuki is already in progress.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The security PIN has been updated.

update_nuki_time.name: Update Nuki time
update_nuki_time.description: Update the Nuki internal date and time.

time.name: New date and time
time.description: Optional. If omitted, use the current UTC time.

set_bluetooth_pairing.name: Set Bluetooth pairing permission
set_bluetooth_pairing.description: Allow or disallow pairing an Opener using its physical button. Requires the stored security PIN. After enabling, start pairing on the Opener itself.

enabled.name: Allow Bluetooth pairing
enabled.description: Allow pairing using the physical button.
